intent: A Skill imported from an Agent Plugin has to be usable on its own although the whole Plugin is stored as a single package.
observable_outcome: Every reader of a stored package opens the directory that Skill Version was validated from, so a Skill that arrived inside a Plugin packages, scans and diffs as the one Skill it is.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Skill Version records the directory inside its stored package that is its own root, and records nothing when the package root already is that root.
Building a downloadable package for a Skill imported from a Plugin succeeds and the result carries that Skill's files at its root, not the Plugin's manifest or its sibling Skills.
The Registry-to-Run fact reader hands over the recorded root alongside the object key, so the consumer never has to guess it.

open_questions: The sandbox provider request still carries only the object key, so a Run of a Plugin-sourced Skill installs the whole archive and the agent discovers no Skill. Closing it changes the provider contract and the runtime image.
